name: PlantRenderDescription + RendererProfile Foundation
purpose: Introduce a deterministic derived PlantRenderDescription and renderer-profile abstraction so visual complexity, assets and LOD can evolve independently of GrowthGraph, genome and ecology truth.
truth_invariants: renderer profile and LOD never modify GrowthGraph
profile changes never modify genome, phenotype, resource, selection or lifecycle truth
TREE/BUSH/GRASS are not renderer or canonical ecology classes
same GrowthGraph deterministically rebuilds the same PlantRenderDescription
all renderer profiles consume the same PlantRenderDescription

accepted_windows_evidence.graphical_note: User confirmed profile switching works without errors; BRANCH_LEAF_INSTANCED, CANOPY_APPROXIMATION and IMPOSTOR_BILLBOARD are visibly distinct while the same GrowthGraph hash is retained for the selected environment.

scope_boundary: PH5-S1 is the representation contract and diagnostic materialization foundation. It does not claim production 3D branch mesh generation, GPU foliage instancing, production canopy clustering or production impostor baking.
next_after_acceptance: ECO.PH5-S2 3D Tapered Branch Tubes + Instanced Foliage
unrelated_blocker_retained: PH3C_FULL_POOL_COMPACT_DOMINANCE remains required before unconstrained morphology mutation/evolution; it does not block renderer research.
